D10.why: the confidence head mis-ranks diffusion samples, measured end to end through the production CLI. Served 0.775 A shipped against 0.760 A repaired, best-of-5 0.679 A, seed floor 0.226 A over 28 pairs -- the repair's gain is inside the floor.
D10.triage_why: The confidence head mis-ranks diffusion samples on the SHIPPED selector, measured end to end through the production CLI on 1UBQ.

D184.why: seventeen parameters receive no gradient on the shipped default. A gradient is not part of a fold.
D184.triage_why: The 99.50523 % coverage figure is arithmetically right and belongs to a default-OFF lever, so the shipped arm still reads 97.98499 % -- seventeen parameters receive no gradient on the default someone gets today. Pass 340

D205.why: 512 aa is the largest crop that runs; 544, 576, 640 and 768 refuse. A user asking for 640 gets an error, not a wrong structure. It is a documented limit and it is real, but it is not a wrong answer.
D205.triage_why: 512 is the largest crop that RUNS: 544, 576, 640 and 768 all refuse, on two different walls -- capacity at 640/768 and CONTIGUITY at 544/576, which a capacity extrapolation cannot see. A capability limit someone using tt

D210.why: 14.2M fused-QKV pad lanes are stepped by Adam. The pad columns are sliced off before v is used, and R152 measured their one other route -- the global-norm clip -- inert on the trajectory at 12.5703x of headroom.
D210.triage_why: 14.2M fused-QKV pad lanes are in the optimizer's parameter set and Adam steps them; upstream does not have them. USER-FACING because a user who trains gets them. R152 measured their one route into other parameters' updat

D24.why: two of the ranking rule's four terms are identically zero on a single chain. Measured INERT for monomers: with iptm and disorder both 0 all four rules reduce to a positive multiple of pTM and serve identical RMSDs sample for sample. Real for complexes and unmeasured there.
D24.triage_why: On a single chain OpenFold3's ranking rule has two of its four terms identically zero -- the shipped default, machine-checked in rank_rule.py.

D32.why: twenty-one sites in nine shipped modules route down a different, unfused path WHILE A TAPE IS OPEN. An inference fold opens none.
D32.triage_why: Twenty-one sites in nine shipped modules route down a different, unfused path while a tape is open, so a training step is a materially different execution.

D55.why: tt_bio's OWN TAPE gives precise_config() to some reductions and withholds it from four. Reached only through the tape.
D55.triage_why: tt_bio's own tape gives precise_config() to the reductions feeding weight gradients and withholds it from four sitting inside near-cancellations.

D58.why: its own triage says USER-FACING 'because the tape is shipped training code'. The forward-to-gradient factor is a training quantity.
D58.triage_why: The forward-to-gradient factor is 11.026x (diffusion) and 10.903x (msa_module) at the repaired denominator, not the ~20x first filed. of3t-tapeamp REFUTED the 'belongs to the tape' half on the diffusion leg: 69.53 %% of

THE_CLAIM.statement: the tracked UNFIXED user-facing set is EIGHT, not six. Two of them (D10, D24) are on the shipped inference selector and were missing from the list for about thirty-five passes; five reach the training tape and one is a capacity refusal.
THE_CLAIM.and_what_the_two_cost: both repairs are built. D10's gain is 0.015 A against a 0.226 A seed floor, and D24's is measured INERT for a single chain. Their consequence is bounded; their existence is not in question.
THE_CLAIM.what_it_is_not: a proof that no other such defect exists. It is a statement about the tracked set, and three user-facing items were already fixed and shipped by pass 363.
THE_CLAIM.nothing_is_reclassified: all six stay USER-FACING. A user who TRAINS is hit by five of them. This adds a distinction, it does not remove a label (reclassifying-out-of-user-facing-is-the-flattering-direction).

THE_SUPPORT_WAS_WEAKER_THAN_IT_READS.the_invariant: inference never imports the training stack, so it never opens a tape -- which is what makes the five training-path defects unreachable from a fold, and is also Moritz's hard stop of 2026-09-21
